description: This file defines the WorkflowsInputService class, which provides methods for mapping and processing workflow update DTOs into schema formats, including handling triggers, steps, and related resources within a NestJS application.

classes.name: WorkflowsInputService
classes.description: A service class for mapping workflow update DTOs to schema formats, handling trigger and step conversions, and resource lookups within a NestJS context.

methods.name: mapEventTypeUpdateDtoToZodSchema
methods.description: Maps an UpdateEventTypeWorkflowDto to a Zod schema format, including steps, trigger, and activation details.

methods.name: mapFormUpdateDtoToZodSchema
methods.description: Maps an UpdateFormWorkflowDto to a Zod schema format, including steps, trigger, and activation details.

methods.name: private _isOffsetTrigger
methods.description: Type guard to check if a trigger is an OffsetTriggerDTOInstancesType.

methods.name: private _getTeamPhoneNumberFromVerifiedId
methods.description: Retrieves a team verified phone number by ID, throws if invalid.

methods.name: private _getTeamEmailFromVerifiedId
methods.description: Retrieves a team verified email by ID, throws if invalid.

methods.name: private mapUpdateWorkflowStepToZodUpdateSchema
methods.description: Converts a step DTO into a schema-compatible object, resolving contact info and message details.

methods.name: private _mapCommonWorkflowProperties
methods.description: Maps common properties like steps, trigger, and timing from DTOs and current data.
